expectations.text: Output follows wiki/templates/region.md structure with filled runnable At a Glance, Current state, and Travel/routes substance — not empty copied headings alone
expectations.evidence: brine-ladder.md has filled Narration, At a Glance, Current state, Routes table (High/Middle/Low with time/risk/cost), Key places — not empty headings.

expectations.text: Frontmatter includes type: region plus scale, kind, and summary
expectations.evidence: type: region; scale: local; kind: frontier; summary present.

expectations.text: Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not vault canon
expectations.evidence: frontmatter invention: true; HTML comment INVENTION; agent_report work gate labels proposed.

expectations.text: Identity sentence appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
expectations.evidence: agent_report.md identity sentence before draft (local frontier… three taxed channels… route choices).

expectations.text: Travel/routes name concrete tradeoffs (time, risk, cost, or discovery), not a single linear path
expectations.evidence: Routes table: High long/lower storm risk; Middle short but storm-closed; Low cheap with scrape risk.

expectations.text: Does not invent Fronts and pressures as established fact without labeling; omits or marks None established / proposed
expectations.evidence: Fronts: None established yet; optional rival feud only if DM asks and labeled invention.

expectations.text: Does not assign an established parent region (e.g. Midchain) as fact for a labeled invention entity without marking that parent assignment as proposed/invention
expectations.evidence: Parent region: '(propose under a Midchain/sea parent — not assigned)' — not asserted as fact.
